name: IsRed_reverse
statement:
import Mathlib

namespace ThreeC2

/-- Free words over three generators -/
abbrev W
proof:
:= List (Fin 3)

local notation x "⁻¹" => List.reverse x

/-- Reduced words do not have the same element adjacent to each other -/
def IsRed (w : W) : Prop := ∀ i, (h : i + 1 < w.length) → w[i] ≠ w[i+1]

theorem IsRed_reverse (w : W) : IsRed (w ⁻¹) → IsRed w := by
  intro h i hi
  symm
  specialize h (w.length - (i+2)) (by simp; omega)
  simp only [List.getElem_reverse, ne_eq] at h
  show ¬_
  convert h using 3 <;> omega

end ThreeC2

import Mathlib

namespace ThreeC2

/-- Free words over three generators -/
abbrev W
proof:
:= List (Fin 3)

local notation x "⁻¹" => List.reverse x

def IsRed (w : W) : Prop := ∀ i, (h : i + 1 < w.length) → w[i] ≠ w[i+1]

@[simp]
theorem IsRed_nil : IsRed [] := by simp [IsRed]

@[simp]
theorem IsRed_singleton x : IsRed [x] := by simp [IsRed]

theorem IsRed_reverse (w : W) : IsRed (w ⁻¹) → IsRed w := by

  show ¬_

theorem IsRed_reverse_iff (w : W) : IsRed (w ⁻¹) ↔ IsRed w :=

theorem IsRed_uncons {x} {ys} (h : IsRed (x :: ys)) : IsRed ys :=
  fun _ hh ↦ h _ (Nat.add_lt_of_lt_sub hh)

theorem IsRed_cons {y} {x} {ys} (hne : y ≠ x) (h : IsRed (x :: ys)) : IsRed (y :: x :: ys) := by
  intro i hi
  match i with
  | 0 => exact hne
  | i+1 => exact h i (Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hi)

lemma IsRed_not_repeated {ys} {x} {xs} : ¬ IsRed (ys ++ x :: x :: xs) := by
  intro h
  specialize h ys.length (by simp)
  rw [List.getElem_append_right] at h
  rotate_left; · simp
  rw [List.getElem_append_right] at h
  rotate_left; · simp
  simp at h

def red (w : W) : W := go [] w
where
  go : (ys xs : W) → W
     | ys, []       => ys.reverse
     | [],    x::xs => go [x] xs
     | y::ys, x::xs =>
      if x = y then
        go ys xs
      else
        go (x::y::ys) xs

  go_aux : (ys xs : W) → (h : IsRed ys) → W
     | ys, [], _       => ys.reverse
     | [],    x::xs, _ => go_aux [x] xs (IsRed_singleton _)
     | y::ys, x::xs, h =>
      if heq : x = y then
        go_aux ys xs (IsRed_uncons h)
      else
        go_aux (x::y::ys) xs (IsRed_cons heq h)

@[simp] theorem red_nil : red [] = [] := rfl
@[simp] theorem red_singleton (x : Fin 3) : red [x] = [x] := rfl

@[simp]
theorem red_duoton_succ (x : Fin 3) : red [x, x+1] = [x, x+1]:= by
  simp! [red]

end ThreeC2

name: red_IsRed
statement:
import Mathlib

namespace ThreeC2

/-- Free words over three generators -/
abbrev W
proof:
:= List (Fin 3)

/-- List reversal is going to be our inverse, so let's introduce convenient notation. -/
local notation x "⁻¹" => List.reverse x

/-- Reduced words do not have the same element adjacent to each other -/
def IsRed (w : W) : Prop := ∀ i, (h : i + 1 < w.length) → w[i] ≠ w[i+1]

@[simp]
theorem IsRed_nil : IsRed [] := by simp [IsRed]

@[simp]
theorem IsRed_singleton x : IsRed [x] := by simp [IsRed]

theorem IsRed_reverse (w : W) : IsRed (w ⁻¹) → IsRed w := by
  intro h i hi
  symm
  specialize h (w.length - (i+2)) (by simp; omega)
  simp only [List.getElem_reverse, ne_eq] at h
  show ¬_
  convert h using 3 <;> omega

@[simp]
theorem IsRed_reverse_iff (w : W) : IsRed (w ⁻¹) ↔ IsRed w :=
  ⟨fun h ↦ IsRed_reverse _ h, fun h ↦ IsRed_reverse _ (by simp [h])⟩

theorem IsRed_uncons {x} {ys} (h : IsRed (x :: ys)) : IsRed ys :=
  fun _ hh ↦ h _ (Nat.add_lt_of_lt_sub hh)

theorem IsRed_cons {y} {x} {ys} (hne : y ≠ x) (h : IsRed (x :: ys)) : IsRed (y :: x :: ys) := by
  intro i hi
  match i with
  | 0 => exact hne
  | i+1 => exact h i (Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hi)

/-!
The reduction function.
-/
def red (w : W) : W := go [] w
where
  go : (ys xs : W) → W
     | ys, []       => ys.reverse
     | [],    x::xs => go [x] xs
     | y::ys, x::xs =>
      if x = y then
        go ys xs
      else
        go (x::y::ys) xs

@[simp] theorem red_nil : red [] = [] := rfl
@[simp] theorem red_singleton (x : Fin 3) : red [x] = [x] := rfl

theorem red.go_IsRed : ∀ (xs ys : W), IsRed ys → IsRed (red.go ys xs) := by
  intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
    intro ys h
    simp only [red.go]
    exact (IsRed_reverse_iff ys).mpr h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro ys h
    match ys with
    | [] =>
      simp only [red.go]
      exact ih [x] (IsRed_singleton x)
    | y :: ys =>
      simp only [red.go]
      split
      · exact ih ys (IsRed_uncons h)
      · rename_i heq
        exact ih (x::y::ys) (IsRed_cons heq h)

@[simp]
theorem red_IsRed (w : W) : IsRed (red w) := red.go_IsRed w [] IsRed_nil

end ThreeC2

name: red.go_length_le
statement:
import Mathlib

namespace ThreeC2

/-- Free words over three generators -/
abbrev W
proof:
:= List (Fin 3)

/-!
The reduction function, nicely concrete and executable and somewhat efficient.
-/
def red (w : W) : W := go [] w
where
  -- A zipper processing helper function.
  go : (ys xs : W) → W
     | ys, []       => ys.reverse
     | [],    x::xs => go [x] xs
     | y::ys, x::xs =>
      if x = y then
        go ys xs
      else
        go (x::y::ys) xs

theorem red.go_length_le (ys xs : W) :
    ys.length ≤ (red.go ys xs).length + xs.length := by
  induction ys, xs using red.go.induct <;> simp_all [red.go] <;> omega

end ThreeC2
